learned.description: Pre-flight socket bind test to verify port availability before launching services.
learned.example: python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1); s.bind(('', PORT)); print('bind ok'); s.close()"

learned.description: Detects and force-clears port collisions before respawning dependent tmux windows.
learned.example: ss -tlnp | grep PORT && lsof -ti:PORT | xargs -r kill -9; sleep 1; tmux respawn-window -t SESSION
